overloads.semanticRole: Starts a database backup immediately using the current backup settings, without prompting the user for confirmation.

constraints: Must not be called from the On Backup Startup or On Backup Shutdown database methods, since BACKUP itself triggers those methods at the start/end of its run (would recurse).
No confirmation dialog is shown; a progress bar appears. On 4D Server, calling from a client runs as a stored procedure but always executes on the server.
